thread:
Ivy Chen: Quick ops thread for Tues webinar (11:00am PT). We're tying the webinar to the Q3 benchmark blog launch so need tight handoffs: registration copy, HubSpot form mapping (we're using native HubSpot form), Zoom recording + captions, edits for launch post, and partner clip delivery. Who takes what?
Rob Morales: I can co-host and own Zoom recording + immediate upload. I'll enable cloud recording, auto-transcript, chat export, and set "Optimize for 3rd party editor."
Kelsey Price: I'll draft the confirmation + 24h/72h nurture cadence and the launch post excerpt. Will include calendar add, link to privacy + distribution consent, and a brief summary for the benchmark narrative.
Danica Ortiz: Content ops here  will turn raw transcript into JSON with sentence timestamps, make 3 highlight clips (2 x 2min + 1 x 45s), and prepare partner packages (MP4 + SRT + trimmed soundbites). ETA 3 hours after upload.
Ivy Chen: HubSpot mapping: email -> email, fullname -> firstname+lastname (split), company -> company, role -> job_title, consent -> marketing_consent. Add hidden utm_campaign=webinar_q3_benchmark and lead_flow=webinar_to_bench. Also tag leads with "benchmark_interest" property.
Rob Morales: Upload path: s3://redwood-marketing/launches/2026-q3-benchmark/${EVENT_SLUG}/recording.mp4. I'll also create speakers.yaml with start offsets and topics.
Kelsey Price: For confirmation copy, include: "We'll share the on-demand recording within 24 hours; captioned transcript available within 48 hours; clips to partners within 72 hours." Also add CTA to read the benchmark preview (link). Draft in thread in 10.
ops-bot: Preflight reminder scheduled: 2026-08-03T17:45:00Z  mic check, co-host set, cloud recording ON, captions ON, HubSpot webhook test. Will ping #marketing 15m before.
Danica Ortiz: Request: leave raw VTT + Zoom transcript JSON. I will run our converter to sentence-level JSON. Also include the cloud recording ID in metadata so we can match versions.
Rob Morales: Will include raw_vtt, transcript.json, cloud_recording_id.txt in the S3 upload. Upload script snippet I'm using:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/recording.mp4 s3://redwood-marketing/launches/2026-q3-benchmark/${EVENT_SLUG}/recording.mp4 --acl private
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/transcript.json s3://redwood-marketing/launches/2026-q3-benchmark/${EVENT_SLUG}/transcript.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom/recording.vtt s3://redwood-marketing/launches/2026-q3-benchmark/${EVENT_SLUG}/recording.vtt
```
Kelsey Price: Legal confirmed the distribution snippet yesterday. Use /legal/snippets/webinar_distribution_2026.txt. Include language about third-party partner delivery.
Ivy Chen: For partner packages, Danica will create a partner-readme.txt with clip timestamps and suggested social copy. Partners: CloudPartnerCo and AnalyticsHouse. Tag in partner CRM after upload.
Danica Ortiz: Noted. I'll add filename conventions: ${EVENT_SLUG}_highlight1.mp4, ${EVENT_SLUG}_social30.mp4, and include SRT and transcript JSON.
Ivy Chen: Post-event emails: 24h send to all registrants with recording + benchmark preview link; 72h reminder to non-viewers linking to the benchmark blog; 1-week push to segmented leads with personalized benchmark snippet. Kelsey will wire HubSpot workflows and create lists: registrants, attendees, non_viewers, benchmark_clickers.
Rob Morales: After upload I will paste both S3 internal path and CloudFront public URL (short-lived) in this thread and tag @Danica @Kelsey. If cloud recording doesn't appear within 30m post end, ops-bot should tag #eng-oncall.
ops-bot: If upload fails or cloud recording missing, alerting #eng-oncall and opening ticket automatically.
Kelsey Price: Draft confirmation posted here: "Thanks for registering! Add to calendar -> [ics]. We'll email the recording within 24 hours. Captions available in 48 hours. By registering you consent to on-demand distribution and partner sharing." Please review.
Danica Ortiz: Small ask: can we request HubSpot to capture timezone field? Makes scheduling follow-ups easier. Ivy ok to add hidden timezone field?
Ivy Chen: Yes, add timezone -> contact.timezone. Good catch.
Rob Morales: Ready to roll. I'll set co-hosts and run the recording preflight now. Will update here with links after upload. :rocket:
